disposition.change: Keep one run per business date in wave 2; record the payment-received same-day trigger as an open question; add an intraday run only when an interface carrying a payment is named.
disposition.note: Run timing belongs to RWB-P8. Step 1 of this story already starts on AceDataReady, so no edit here.

disposition.change: State the receipt count per business date as the receipt-to-installment ratio observed on busy-month ACE data in the next NFR version.
disposition.note: No receipt volume is in the sources. The volume test uses the ratio as an assumption until NFR Spec v3 is revised.

disposition.change: Keep the rwb-decision placement and split the record: rwb-payment writes and publishes the local record; rwb-decision holds package, rows and tests, collects records, appends to ledger and runs JOB-14, evaluates no payment.
disposition.note: This story stays on rwb-source-data and writes no decision record. The split is recorded on the Work Package line.

disposition.change: Fix one DecisionRecorded shape and one consumer group; take decision codes from LOV-DECISION; carry inputs_ref as opaque; keep the input age limit key as a DP-06 placeholder; publish the decision-log read page default.
disposition.note: Record shape, codes and read belong to rwb-payment and rwb-decision. This story names none of them and writes no record.

disposition.change: Publish v1 with the two operations, three event schemas, nine declarations, schema baseline and message map; mark unsettled elements with the placeholder and one review row; gate the tag on contract tests and schema lint.
disposition.note: Contract elements of rwb-payment are published in RWB-P8-E2008-CON. This story consumes only its rwb-source-data elements and keeps the dependency.

disposition.change: Ship one chart with api and worker deployments, migration job, topic and two consumer groups, five alerts with runbook links, four dashboard series, flag, backfill and rollback; take thresholds as environment values.
disposition.note: Deployment values belong to rwb-payment. This story's deployment is rwb-source-data's and takes no value from them.

disposition.change: Apply the match on ProceedsMatched and the miss on PaymentMissed through the inbox of rwb-treatment; name activities applyProceedsMatched and holdMissedInstallment; serve the position in the API-S2-002 treatment read.
disposition.note: Plan route and treatment read belong to rwb-treatment. Steps 7 and 9 of this story already leave the plan position there.

disposition.change: Publish the three event schemas (TreatmentBooked, PaymentMissed, ProceedsMatched) with their data fields and the CloudEvents envelope; keep the decision-record element with its library owner; new version for any added business field.
disposition.note: Event schemas belong to RWB-P8-E2008-CON. This story publishes no event (step 9), so it needs no change.

disposition.change: Contract dependencies now lists RWB-P3-E1043-CON for the reference-data read of the data product list and source-system list.
disposition.note: Gap stays open against the story until RWB-P3-E1043-CON is published; reference reads stay on the client library and fixture until then.
